scope: Headless Chromium, real worker/Web Audio; font served locally. Four starts per cold context; dev compilation warmed outside measurement. Renderer 4x is simulated, not physical slow-device qualification. Scheduling time is not audible attack time. Small cold n is descriptive.
normalizationNotes: Early context-wide underflow counters were converted to per-start deltas while preserving underflowsCumulative.

The early selection-first-chunk label meant startupBufferSeconds=0 with merging=0.5 and minStartupBatches=3; renamed selection-zero-startup-buffer and the original label retained. The separate scheduler-policy baseline also measures a genuine first-chunk/unmerged/minimum-one-batch candidate.
Peak source counts are instrumented high-water observations; post-Stop retained source counts and WASM heap capacity are the memory comparisons used in the execution record.
